description: Find vacation rentals listed by their owners that are booked directly on the owner's own website (no platform fees). Filter by place, dates, guests, pets and nightly price. With checkIn and checkOut, only stays open for those dates are returned. Returns up to 25 stays with photo, price, owner-reported rating and booking link.

guests.description: Number of guests the stay must sleep

pets.description: true = only stays that allow pets

where.description: Town, state, region or kind of place, e.g. "McMinnville", "Oregon wine country", "lake Alabama"

name: search_stays
title: Search vacation rentals
